title: 第23章 这一天到来第24章 誓约决斗
content_zh:
;;
阳光刺在眼皮上，将视野映得一片通红。
克洛伊睫毛颤了几下，偏过头，睁开了眼。
他吧唧了两下嘴，手便忍不住抬起来盖在了额头上。
昨天早上的那种不得劲感更加强烈了。
那种整个人被一层无形的网包裹住的滞涩感……
用力揉揉眉心，抬眼看向墙壁上的挂钟。
克洛伊眯着眼辨认了一下，然后微微一愣：“九点半？”
他本以为这会儿时间还早呢！
毕竟昨晚他这么早就回了宿舍。
但仔细想想也是，毕竟经历了连续三天大大小小不知道几百次的生死搏杀，他的实战经验和战斗技巧增长不是一点两点，至少昨晚他面对那道身影时，已经有了一定程度的还手能力，死亡的间隔时间大大增加。
其中甚至有一次他都爆掉了对面的一条腿，但可惜的时候与之相对的是自己的脑袋被对面给爆掉了。
话说决斗时间是几点来着？
哦，想起来了，上午十点。
克洛伊一拍脑门，掀开被子就跳下了床。
飞快洗漱一通，克洛伊拉开了自己的衣柜。
目光掠过一件件衣物和制服，最后他将手伸向了最里面那套极其华丽耀眼的白色长款战衣上。
在克洛伊的记忆里，那件衣服是他入学时，母亲给他准备的。
但他却一次都没有穿过，盖因是上面有着多处用秘银丝线绣着的多铎家冰霜纹章，而原本的克洛伊也有着些许自知之明吧……
既然已经决定了要彻底扭转克洛伊过往的形象，那么就从这第一战开始，一转到底。

他不知道凭借自己目前这经过数百次死亡磨砺出来的实战能力，能否战胜那位天资卓绝的希琳公主，但他绝对会全力以赴，将自己最好的一面——或者说，是“藏拙”
多年后该展现的一面，公之于众。
拿出衣服，披到身上，克洛伊转身，推开了宿舍门，金色的阳光洒在了他身上。
......
皇家决斗场内，此时早已是人声鼎沸。
足以容纳千人以上规模的环形观众席上早已座无虚席，许多后来的学生和闻讯而来的看客们甚至只能挤在过道和后排的空隙里。
喧嚣的声浪如同实质般在巨大的圆形空间内回荡，空气中弥漫着一种混合了兴奋好奇与期待的躁动。
巨大的圆形擂台以某种坚不可摧的暗色金属打造而成，表面铭刻着密密麻麻的防护符文，确保决斗的能量不会外泄伤及观众。
擂台中央，希琳公主静静盘坐着。
她身着一套红白相间的贴身战衣，勾勒出挺拔而矫健的身姿，灿金色的长发被一根简单的发绳束在脑后，几缕发丝垂落在光洁的额前。
她那柄装饰华贵且锋利无比的长剑此刻正平放在她的双膝之上，剑身映照着决斗场上空的魔法灯光，流转着森寒的光泽。

The sun pierced the eyelids, making the field of vision red.
Chloe's eyelashes trembled a few times, she turned her head and opened her eyes.
He chirped twice and couldn't help but raise his hand to cover his forehead.
The sense of dissatisfaction I felt yesterday morning was even stronger.
That sluggish feeling that the whole person is wrapped in an invisible net...
He rubbed his eyebrows vigorously and looked up at the clock on the wall.
Chloe squinted her eyes to identify it, and then was slightly stunned: "Nine-thirty?"
He thought it was still early!
After all, he returned to the dormitory so early last night.
But think about it carefully. After all, after three consecutive days and hundreds of life-and-death fights, his actual combat experience and combat skills have increased by more than a little. At least when he faced that figure last night, he already had a certain degree of ability to fight back, and the time between death was greatly increased.
On one occasion, he even blew off one of the opponent's legs, but unfortunately, his own head was blown off by the opponent.
By the way, what time is the duel?
Oh, I remember, ten o'clock in the morning.
Chloe slapped her forehead, lifted the quilt and jumped out of bed.
After washing up quickly, Chloe opened her closet.
His eyes passed over each piece of clothing and uniforms, and finally he reached out to the extremely gorgeous and dazzling long white battle suit at the bottom.
In Chloe's memory, that dress was prepared for him by his mother when he entered school.
But he has never worn it once, because it has multiple frost emblems of the Dodo family embroidered with mithril thread, and the original Chloe must have had some self-awareness...
Now that we have decided to completely change Chloe's past image, we will start from this first battle and go all the way.
He doesn't know whether he can defeat the extremely talented Princess Shireen with his current combat ability, which has been honed by hundreds of deaths, but he will definitely go all out and use his best side - or in other words, his "hidden clumsiness"
The side that should be shown after many years is made public.
Taking out his clothes and putting them on his body, Chloe turned around and pushed open the dormitory door, letting the golden sunshine shine on him.
...
The royal duel arena was already buzzing with people.
The circular auditorium, which can accommodate more than a thousand people, was already full. Many late students and onlookers who came after hearing the news could only squeeze into the aisles and the gaps in the back rows.
The noisy sound echoed in the huge circular space like substance, and the air was filled with a kind of restlessness mixed with excitement, curiosity and expectation.
The huge circular arena is made of some kind of indestructible dark metal, with dense protective runes engraved on the surface to ensure that the energy of the duel will not leak out and harm the audience.
In the center of the ring, Princess Shireen sat cross-legged quietly.
She was wearing a red and white close-fitting battle suit, outlining a tall and strong figure. Her long golden hair was tied back by a simple hair rope, and a few strands of hair fell down on her smooth forehead.
Her luxuriously decorated and extremely sharp long sword was currently lying flat on her knees. The blade of the sword reflected the magic lights above the duel field, giving off a cold luster.
